title: One shop, one evening

blocks.text: We stood outside one shop on the evening of the last count. Most people who stopped came for a pick-up, and pick-ups are channel B orders.

blocks.alt: A shop with a striped awning and a lit window, two people standing outside it at dusk.
blocks.caption: The shop, cropped from the street photo.

reading.text: A photo of one shop at dusk, with a striped awning and a lit window and two people outside it. Most people who stopped there came for a pick-up, which is a channel B order.
